description: Demonstration of the FANS-type small-strain J2 laws: linear plus saturating (Voce) isotropic hardening and linear Prager kinematic hardening. Add "viscosity" (GPa s) and pass --load-rate for Perzyna viscoplasticity; hardening 0 without saturation is perfect plasticity.

units.viscosity: GPa s, overstress q - R = 3/2 viscosity dp/dt
